metadata.description: Practical, tested Agent Skills for Claude Code and Claude.ai — docs, code review, infra and learning workflows.

plugins.name: md-to-doc
plugins.description: Markdown → Word/PDF with intact tables and an automatic PDF-engine fallback chain (typst, LaTeX, LibreOffice, MS Word).

plugins.name: anti-slop-editor
plugins.description: Edit prose so it stops sounding AI-generated, keeping the author's meaning and voice.

plugins.name: stacked-pr-splitter
plugins.description: Split a large branch/PR into a lossless stack of small, independently mergeable PRs.

plugins.name: pr-explainer-quiz
plugins.description: Explain a PR with a diagram and risk notes, then quiz the reviewer to confirm they understood it.

plugins.name: oss-ready
plugins.description: Get a repo ready to go public: secret + history scan, internal-reference sweep, license and community files.

plugins.name: incident-postmortem
plugins.description: Turn incident threads, alerts and metrics into a blameless postmortem with a UTC timeline and owned action items.

plugins.name: terraform-plan-reviewer
plugins.description: Review Terraform/OpenTofu/Terragrunt plans: flags data-loss replaces, IAM widening, open ingress, disabled protections.

plugins.name: codebase-viva-prep
plugins.description: Prepare to defend a codebase in a viva or interview: architecture map, predicted questions, mock viva, live-change drills.
